issue.title: [dualtor] multiple traffic tests report traffic disruption prior to/at beginning of the test

resolution.title: [dualtor]: Improve tests
resolution.description:
- Create separate folder for dualtor IO testing
- Adjust dualtor test initialization timing to reduce flakiness
- Do not restart mux simulator before each test module

Signed-off-by: Lawrence Lee <<EMAIL>>
